cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.58%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -0.99%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +21.58%, BE +9.46%, ENPH +9.26%, TLN +8.55%, GEV +7.23%. Laggards: FANG -2.27%, MPLX -1.93%, APA -1.70%, UUUU -1.62%.
